headline: LinkedIn spent $5,417 over 14 days with zero conversions and is paused; Meta CPA is up about 50% and trimmed 15%; direct growth looks AI-driven, not paid.

moves.reason: Zero conversions for 14 days (since 10/18) on $5,417 spend while daily spend climbed from $275 to $477. Weeks of 10/19 and 10/26 each had 0 conv vs 9-14/wk before. Pure waste or broken tracking; either way pause, easy to reverse.

CPA up from ~$60 (before 9/28) to ~$91 after (1.5x; last 3 wks $87 vs $65 earlier, +35%) on flat spend (~$3.4-3.5k/wk). ROAS 2.0 is still above the 1.5 target under all models (2.74-4.07 implied), so trim 15% only and confirm with a test.

tests.hypothesis: Meta's CPA deterioration since 9/28 reflects real loss of incremental conversions, not tracking/attribution change; Meta's true value sits between last-touch ROAS 2.0 and first-touch 4.07.
tests.design: Geo holdout: pause Meta in ~20% of matched regions for 3-4 weeks. Measure total conversions (all channels incl. direct) and revenue vs control regions, plus self-reported 'Instagram or Facebook ad' share (fell from ~18% to ~10%). Also audit pixel/CAPI event health around 9/28.

tests.hypothesis: The rise in direct conversions (2.0 to 7.7/day since 10/11) is driven by AI assistant recommendations (self-reported AI answers 8% to 22%), not paid media.
tests.design: Add a dedicated 'AI assistant / ChatGPT' option and UTM/referrer capture for AI-referral traffic; track direct landing pages and branded search volume for 4 weeks. Do not shift paid budget until confirmed.

flag_verdicts.reason: LinkedIn had 0 conversions for 14 days on $5,417 while daily spend rose from $275 to $477. Paused. Check LinkedIn tracking before re-enabling.
Meta CPA went from $60 to $91 (1.5x) since 9/28 on flat spend. Trimmed 15% and recommended a geo holdout. ROAS is still above the 1.5 target under every model, so no deeper cut.
The 9/12-9/18 Google spike (week of 9/14 spend $6.7k) held CPA at $20.82 vs $18-19, and CPA has since fallen to about $15.6. Efficiency did not drop with the spend, so no action.

Direct rose from 2.0 to 7.7/day while paid spend moved 1.04x. Self-reported AI answers (AI assistant plus ChatGPT) rose from about 8% to 22%. This points to untracked AI referrals, so I credited no paid channel. Test tracking.

flags.message: linkedin spent $5,417 over 14 days with zero conversions, and spend is still rising.
meta CPA rose 1.5x, from $60 to $91, starting 2026-09-28.
google_search spend jumped for 7 days (2026-09-12 to 2026-09-18); CPA held at $22 vs $19. Likely fine, confirm before acting.
Direct conversions grew 3.9x (2.0 to 7.7/day) while paid spend moved 1.04x. Self-reported AI answers went from 8% to 22%. Something untracked is driving buyers.
